title: 1982 Donruss #114 Gary Carter Montreal Expos Baseball Card

descriptionText: This 1982 Donruss sports trading card features Gary Carter of the Major League Baseball (MLB) team Expos. The card number is 114 and it belongs to the base set. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection. The card is from the 1982 season and was manufactured by Donruss. It is a must-have for any serious collector. The card is in great shape and would make a wonderful gift for a fellow sports fan.
